standard.summary: 将 caption 按分隔符分为多个组，在每个组内部打乱标签顺序，但保持组之间的相对顺序。比全局 shuffle 更精细。default-off。
standard.effect: tag_group_separator 指定分隔符（默认 '|||'）。组内标签随机排列，组之间保持原始顺序。开启时优先于全局 shuffle_caption。
standard.whenToUse: caption 有明确的分层结构时（如 '触发词 ||| 外观描述 ||| 背景描述'）。想保持描述层级但增加组内多样性。
standard.avoidWhen: caption 没有分层结构时。需要整段完全随机时用 shuffle_caption。

standard_en.summary: Splits the caption into groups on a separator and shuffles the tags within each group while keeping the groups in their relative order. Finer-grained than a global shuffle. Off by default.
standard_en.effect: tag_group_separator names the separator (default '|||'). Tags are permuted within a group while the groups keep their original order. When enabled it takes precedence over the global shuffle_caption.
standard_en.whenToUse: When the caption has a clear layered structure ('trigger word ||| appearance description ||| background description', say). When you want to keep the description hierarchy but add variety within each group.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When the caption has no layered structure. Use shuffle_caption when you want the whole thing fully randomised.

advanced.principle: caption 示例：'sks girl, 1girl ||| red hair, blue eyes ||| outdoor, sunset'。组内打乱后可能变成：'sks girl, 1girl ||| blue eyes, red hair ||| sunset, outdoor'。与 caption_tag_mutate_scope=after_separator 叠加时：先切 head/tail，只对可变区做 group shuffle，head 不动。
advanced.intervention: CaptionDataset._process_caption → shuffle_tags_groups_flexible（token 边界或字符串级多组）。group on 时替换全局 random.shuffle。
advanced.expectedImpact: 比全局 shuffle 更好地保持 prompt 结构理解。多概念训练中减少概念混淆。
advanced.tradeoffs: 需要标注时就有意识地分层。分隔符需与数据一致。

advanced_en.principle: Caption example: 'sks girl, 1girl ||| red hair, blue eyes ||| outdoor, sunset'. After group shuffling it might become: 'sks girl, 1girl ||| blue eyes, red hair ||| sunset, outdoor'. Combined with caption_tag_mutate_scope=after_separator: the head/tail are split first, group shuffle applies only to the mutable region, and the head stays put.
advanced_en.intervention: CaptionDataset._process_caption → shuffle_tags_groups_flexible (token boundaries or string-level multi-group). When group is on it replaces the global random.shuffle.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Preserves prompt-structure understanding better than global shuffle; reduces concept confusion in multi-concept training.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Layer tags deliberately at annotation time if you want grouping. The separator must match your data.
